Make a project this directory's: commands run here, and in the directories below, act on it. The
link is yours, kept in ~/.voidhash, not in the repository. Without a project, asks which.

Usage:
  voidhash link [project] [flags]

Arguments:
  project  The project's slug, organization/slug, name or id

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash link acme/app
  voidhash link
